description: Use for a seller's customer feedback (service, shipping). Not for product reviews (product_reviews). Returns paginated seller feedback, optionally filtered to a star-rating window. Price: $0.003 per call. from_rating and to_rating are optional; omit both for unfiltered feedback. A page holds 5 reviews and the answer carries current_page and has_next_page; Amazon exposes no total, so page until has_next_page is false (up to page 100).

compact.description: Return light rows: identity, price, rating, badges and one delivery_date, dropping the long delivery prose that repeats itself across three fields. false returns every field the REST API sends (roughly 3x the size).
compact.title: Compact

fields.description: Comma-separated row fields to return instead of the light set, e.g. "asin,product_title,product_price". Rows list what they left out under _omitted_fields.
fields.title: Fields

limit.description: How many seller reviews to return from this page (0 = all of them). A full page is up to 48 rows and about 54 KB, which most clients spill to a file instead of showing inline. The answer carries _truncated with the true count when it trims.
limit.title: Limit

page.description: Result page, 1-based, 5 reviews a page; has_next_page in the answer says whether another exists.
page.title: Page

seller_id.description: Amazon seller id: 'A' followed by 9-20 letters and digits, the seller= or me= value of a storefront URL (e.g. A2A1RNLLUK3HYA). Required.
seller_id.title: Seller Id

name: seller_reviews
title: Feedback reviews for a seller
